verdict.rationale: Sales Cloud pricing lists access to AgentExchange, Salesforce's own marketplace. There you can find and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents and MCP servers inside Agentforce Builder, which is a first-party way to install prebuilt third-party components. The marketplace is framed around agents and MCP servers rather than general app integrations, and none of the named integration types is evidenced. Missing for 10: evidence of a general app integration marketplace, specific prebuilt Slack, support desk, marketing and data warehouse integrations, documentation of the install flow for ops users, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can install prebuilt integrations (Slack, support desk, marketing, data warehouse) from an app marketplace

citations.quote: you can find, evaluate, and plug in trusted third-party agents, sub-agents, and MCP servers directly within Agentforce Builder
